title: Vietnamese Tofu Noodle Soup
description: A light and refreshing Vietnamese-inspired noodle soup made with crispy tofu and unique noodles. Perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large pot, combine the vegetable broth, soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar. Bring to a simmer.
Add the cubed tofu to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chopped spring rolls to the pot and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the lime juice and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
Serve the noodles on the side or add them to the soup.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
